front_content.text:
Only after the ethics committee reviewed the revised protocol did the researchers resume the field trial.

为什么主句用 did the researchers resume，而不是普通语序？

back_content.text: Only after... 提到句首，主句发生部分倒装，用 did＋主语＋动词原形。
back_content.explanation: 正常语序是 The researchers resumed...only after...。提前 Only after... 突出只有伦理委员会复核后才恢复，过去时由 did 承担，resume 回到原形；这仍是在陈述事实。

analysis_content.text: 正常语序是 The researchers resumed...only after...。提前 Only after... 突出只有伦理委员会复核后才恢复，过去时由 did 承担，resume 回到原形；这仍是在陈述事实。
tips: 把 Only after... 移回句末，再比较主句语序。

front_content.text:
Never have the auditors encountered such a large discrepancy in a routine compliance check.

为什么 have 在 the auditors 前？

back_content.text: B。Never 前置使主句部分倒装，强调此前从未遇到这么大的差异。
back_content.explanation: 普通语序是 The auditors have never encountered...。Never 移到句首后，助动词 have 移到主语前；并不是询问他们是否遇到过。

analysis_content.text: 普通语序是 The auditors have never encountered...。Never 移到句首后，助动词 have 移到主语前；并不是询问他们是否遇到过。
tips: 对照 have never encountered 与 Never have...encountered。

options.text: It is an ordinary yes-no question asking whether the auditors encountered the discrepancy.
Fronting Never places have before the subject and emphasizes that the auditors have never encountered such a discrepancy.
Never modifies discrepancy only, so no inversion is involved.
The correct form should be Never the auditors have encountered...

front_content.text:
Had the archive not been digitized in time, several crucial records would have been lost during the flood.

给条件句补回 if，语序应怎样恢复？

back_content.text: If the archive had not been digitized in time, several crucial records would have been lost during the flood.
back_content.explanation: 省去 if 时，had 可移到主语前。恢复后是 If the archive had not been...，not 仍在主语后的 had 之后；句子设想过去未及时数字化可能造成的损失。

analysis_content.text: 省去 if 时，had 可移到主语前。恢复后是 If the archive had not been...，not 仍在主语后的 had 之后；句子设想过去未及时数字化可能造成的损失。
tips: 恢复为 If＋主语＋had not been...。
